title: Big Globe Compat - GeOre
description: This datapack adds compatibility between GeOre and Big Globe.
body:
This datapack adds all of the GeOre types of geodes to the terrain generation in the style of Big Globe's geodes, though a little smaller.

These geodes spawn where magic is higher in the world, with the rare geodes spawning deeper than common geodes.

Common Geodes: Coal, Copper, Iron, Ruby, Sapphire, Topaz, Zinc 
Rare Geodes: Diamond, Emerald, Gold, Lapis, Redstone
